skill.name: dbs-video-extract
skill.description: 从抖音、小红书、微信视频号等平台链接或分享文案查询作品／账号数据并提取语音文字稿，按作者和标题归档为 Markdown。用户要求解析平台视频或取得数据、文字稿时使用；需配置 TikHub 与轻抖凭证，不负责本地成片章节导航或导航视频渲染。
skill.summary: Query short-video metadata and archive speech transcripts as Markdown using TikHub and Qingdou.
skill.author: dontbesilent2025

security_audit.summary: Most static flags reflect documented credential handling, Markdown syntax, or platform identifiers rather than malicious behavior. Confirmed risks concern credential-bearing redirects, HTTP endpoint overrides, and unrestricted URL resolution; seven static locations cover these three issues. No evidence found of malicious intent or prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Authenticated urllib requests preserve sensitive headers across cross-host redirects and HTTPS downgrades.
remediation.suggestion: Disable authenticated redirects, or require same-origin HTTPS destinations and strip sensitive headers before any origin change.

remediation.issue: Both transcription entry points accept QINGDOU_BASE_URL without requiring HTTPS.
remediation.suggestion: Validate Qingdou endpoints centrally before loading or sending credentials; reject HTTP and require explicit consent for nonstandard hosts.

remediation.issue: The standalone Douyin resolver requests arbitrary input URLs and follows unchecked redirects.
remediation.suggestion: Require approved Douyin HTTPS hosts before fetching; validate every redirect and block loopback, private, link-local, and reserved destination addresses.

content.user_title: Extract Short-Video Data and Speech Transcripts
content.value_statement: Short-video links often separate useful metadata from spoken content. This skill combines TikHub data queries and Qingdou transcription, then saves transcripts as organized Markdown files.
actual_capabilities: Query Douyin video metadata and user profiles through TikHub MCP.
Retrieve Xiaohongshu video-note and WeChat Channels video metadata through dedicated TikHub MCP tools.
Submit complete share text to Qingdou and poll for speech transcription results.
Save transcripts as Markdown with source metadata, organized by author and title.
Run data-only, transcript-only, or combined extraction while preserving successful results when one service fails.
Detect configured credentials locally and skip existing same-source transcripts unless overwrite is requested.
limitations: Requires Python and configured provider credentials; TikHub queries and Qingdou transcription may incur separate charges.
Dedicated metadata parsing supports only Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat Channels; other transcription support depends on Qingdou.
Cannot guarantee access to private, deleted, restricted, or unsupported videos, or guarantee transcription accuracy.
Does not download media, render navigation videos, or provide an offline transcription engine.

use_cases.title: Archive source material
use_cases.description: Save spoken content and source metadata from permitted public videos into an organized Markdown research archive.

use_cases.title: Inspect short-video performance
use_cases.description: Retrieve available engagement statistics and author details without requesting transcription when only metadata is needed.

use_cases.title: Review published speech
use_cases.description: Extract a transcript from a published video for manual editorial review while retaining the original service output.

prompt_templates.title: Check readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check which credentials are configured for dbs-video-extract. Report available capabilities without showing secrets or making network requests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect local configuration before extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Extract one transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract only the speech transcript from [video share text]. Save it under [output directory] and report the resulting Markdown path.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: transcribe one supported video through Qingdou.

prompt_templates.title: Combine data and speech
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract metadata and speech from [video share text] into [output directory]. Preserve either successful result if one service fails, and report limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: retrieve both outputs from one share message.

prompt_templates.title: Control extraction and regeneration
prompt_templates.prompt: Process [Douyin video share text] in combined mode using stdin. Prefer App data with Web fallback, retain raw metadata, and preserve existing transcripts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: control input handling, data fallback, and file preservation.

output_examples.input: Check readiness when only TikHub is configured.
output_examples.output: TikHub credentials are configured. Metadata queries are available; speech transcription requires Qingdou credentials. This local check does not validate authentication, balance, or service availability.

output_examples.input: Illustrative successful extraction of a public video titled Morning Routine by Sample Creator.
output: Metadata query: successful. Available author, title, and engagement fields are included in the summary.
Speech transcript: saved under the selected output directory in Sample Creator/Morning Routine.md.
The Markdown file includes source metadata and the returned transcript.

output_examples.input: Illustrative combined extraction where metadata succeeds but transcription reports insufficient resources.
output_examples.output: Partial success: metadata was retained. Qingdou transcription failed because the provider reported insufficient resources. No transcript file was created.

best_practices: Configure credentials through the hidden-input helper and keep keys out of chat, repositories, and logs.
Review provider charges and use only content you are authorized to process.
Pass share text through stdin, keep default HTTPS endpoints, and preserve existing transcripts unless regeneration is explicitly required.
anti_patterns: Treating credential discovery as proof of valid authentication, sufficient balance, or working provider access.
Requesting media downloads, local video rendering, or offline transcription from this extraction skill.
Using untrusted endpoint overrides or assuming arbitrary links and redirects are safe.

faq.question: Which platforms support metadata queries?
faq.answer: Dedicated metadata queries support Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat Channels. Douyin also supports user profile links.

faq.question: Do I need both provider keys?
faq.answer: No. TikHub enables metadata queries, and Qingdou enables speech transcription. Combined extraction requires both for full results.

faq.question: Is extraction free?
faq.answer: The skill is free and open source. External providers may charge for queries or transcription according to their current plans.

faq.question: Where are transcripts saved?
faq.answer: Transcripts are saved as Markdown under the selected output directory, grouped by author and title. Missing authors use a fallback folder.

faq.question: Will existing transcripts be overwritten?
faq.answer: Existing transcripts for the same source are skipped by default. Overwriting requires an explicit overwrite option.

faq.question: What happens when one service fails?
faq.answer: The combined workflow retains successful results and reports partial success when one requested service succeeds and another fails.
